name: Laughing Men In Suits
look: A vintage photo of about eight men in dark suits crowded into an elegant room, all laughing hard. Several, including Ronald Reagan at left, hold wine or champagne glasses, an older man in glasses doubles over in front, and a man at far right laughs into his hand.
use: Shows powerful people laughing at an outrageous or out-of-touch idea. The caption usually reads "And then I said..." followed by something absurd, greedy or unrealistic, as if it were the funniest joke in the room.
slots: bottom caption: the absurd or out-of-touch idea
examples: "Unlimited vacation, but nobody is allowed to take any"
"The update will only take five minutes"
describe: group of old men in suits laughing hysterically
businessmen holding drinks and cracking up
rich guys in suits laughing at a joke
reagan and other men in a room laughing with champagne
old guys in suits bent over laughing together
origin: A White House photo of President Ronald Reagan laughing with a group of men over drinks.
